name: Opt-in projectile interception and point defense
summary: Adds inert-by-default interception tags to native Missile and Bullet projectiles plus a reusable armament-driven defense trait. Intercepted projectiles may be removed harmlessly or configured to detonate at the interception point.

sources.notes: Primary behavior reference. The adaptation uses native projectiles and makes harmless interception the default instead of always applying the incoming weapon impact.

integration.migration_notes: Set PointDefenseType only on projectiles intended to be interceptable. Inherit ^ReusablePointDefense or configure the trait directly, then replace the fixture weapon/range/reload with faction-specific balance. Existing projectiles are unaffected.

evidence: Isolated Debug build of OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/OpenRA.Mods.Common completed with 0 errors.
OpenRA.Utility ra --check-yaml passed with point-defense actor and weapon fixtures and all bundled RA maps, sequences, and Fluent references validated.
